## Findings
- claim-1: Conditional on the stipulated integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation, the requested exact row-matrix certificates \(R_{\mathrm{full}}=CR_{\mathrm{selected}}\) are established in all regimes \(p=q-i\ge1,\ c=r-j\ge1,\ \min(p,c)=1\), with \(i,j\ge2\). The matrices and all boundary deletions are given below.
- claim-2: In the regime \(c=1,\ p\ge3\), the certificate gives the requested check \[ h_2y_1=h_1u+h_1z+h_1y_2-h_2x_1. \]
- claim-3: The ambient integral box/Schur/Pieri presentation is assumed here, not independently established in this certificate.
## Strategy
Revalidate conditionally on the stipulated box/Schur/Pieri presentation by independently enumerating all degree-\(d+3\) box partitions \(A,\ldots,J\), applying every relevant \(h_1,h_2,h_3\) Pieri product, and forming \(R_{\mathrm{full}}\) in the stipulated displayed column order. For each regime and boundary deletion (\(p=1,2\), \(c=1,2\), \(i=2\), \(j=2\)), derive the nonselected rows independently and check entrywise the stated integral identity
\[
R_{\mathrm{full}}=C R_{\mathrm{selected}}.
\]
In particular, for \(c=1,\ p\ge3\), verify from Pieri coordinates that
\[
h_2y_1=C+F+G
=h_1u+h_1z+h_1y_2-h_2x_1,
\]
with the \(G\)-coordinate deleted when \(i=2\).

## Gaps
The supplied record does not contain the displayed degree-\(d+3\) column list \(A,\ldots,J\), the full and selected row matrices, or the regime-specific matrices \(C\). Hence the required identities cannot be checked or reproduced from this input.

Accepted artifact `c523b9a65c6908594380392aa237d0d15e3a53c7154d8f26dc0882ce1754659d` verifies only lower-degree identities and a doubly-boundary matrix; it is not evidence for \(R_{\mathrm{full}}=CR_{\mathrm{selected}}\) in degree \(d+3\).

No task-owned degree-\(d+3\) exhaustive Pieri computation artifact is supplied. Thus the requested integrated matrix certificate remains unresolved here.

## Next
Provide the missing displayed matrices and column order, together with either:

1. an exhaustive symbolic Pieri table including all stated deletions and entrywise matrix products; or  
2. a task-owned executable degree-\(d+3\) enumeration artifact recording inputs, all regime matrices, \(CR_{\mathrm{selected}}-R_{\mathrm{full}}\), output, exit status, and digest.

No parent-theorem conclusion follows from this unresolved certificate.
